senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Kidon; גורן כ׳ the threshing floor of K. (I Chr. XIII, 9), in place of נָכוֹן (II Sam. VI, 6).
units: <cite ref="Sotah 35b:5">Sot. 35ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>בתחלה כ׳ וכ׳</he> at first (the Ark was shaking like) a javelin (v. <cite ref="K00494">preced.</cite>), but afterwards (it was) firmly established; [oth. interpret., v. Rashi to Sot. l. c.]
